shared_elements: large-scale relief figure(s) shown in profile
bearded male figure with elaborate headdress
figure grasping a long shaft/spear-like weapon
patterned, detailed rendering of hair/beard in rows of curls
fringed or layered garment with rows of tassel-like detail
figure feet in profile on a groundline
justification: Both surfaces show monumental profile relief figures with curled, patterned beards and elaborate headgear, and in each a male figure grips a long shaft/spear diagonally across the body, with garments rendered as rows of pleats and fringes — a fairly specific shared convention of royal/guardian relief imagery. The biggest difference in content is that B includes a hybrid winged, scaled lion-bird monster and a winged human-headed being locked in a confrontation, whereas A shows only a single calm standing attendant with no wings, no creature and no combat.
